final_message:
Fixed. `Crème brûlée recipes` now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

**The change** is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before calling `slugify`, the title is decomposed into base letters plus combining accent marks, and those marks are dropped. So `é` becomes `e` instead of being deleted.

**Why not fix it in the library:** the accent handling lives in `vendor/slugify`, which is pinned to 1.2.0. Its changelog says 1.2.1 fixed this by transliterating accents. Per `CLAUDE.md` and `vendor/README.md`, I didn't edit `vendor/`, and the platform team owns upgrades. Once they upgrade to 1.2.1, this workaround may be unnecessary, though it's harmless to keep.

**Not changed:** `src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the same `slugify`, so product URLs with accented names still lose those letters. That's outside the blog-slug task, so I left it alone. The same one-line normalization would fix it if you want it.
